id: \bYou may not know this but most Pokémon have found ways to evolve outside of trading. Take Kadabra for example. It now evolves at level 35.
en: \bYou may not know this but most Pokémon have found ways to evolve outside of trading. Take Kadabra for example. It now evolves at level 35.
it: \bForse non lo sai, ma la maggior parte dei Pokémon ha trovato il modo di evolversi senza bisogno di scambi. Prendi Kadabra, per esempio: ora si evolve al livello 35.

id: \bIf you don't know how they evolve try talking to my friends.
en: \bIf you don't know how they evolve try talking to my friends.
it: \bSe non sai come si evolvono, prova a parlare con i miei amici.

id: \bThey are in Viridian City, Cherrygrove City, Oldale Town, Twinleaf Town, Accumula Town, Santalune City, Iki Town, and Hammerlocke.
en: \bThey are in Viridian City, Cherrygrove City, Oldale Town, Twinleaf Town, Accumula Town, Santalune City, Iki Town, and Hammerlocke.
it: \bSi trovano a Smeraldopoli, Fiorpescopoli, Solarosa, Duefoglie, Quattroventi, Novartopoli, Lili e Hammerlocke.
